description: Minor inconvenience for a single user.
example_conditions: Cosmetic issues, documentation requests, single-user non-blocker.

description: Standard support request affecting one user or a small group.
example_conditions: Single user blocked from non-critical workflow, small team partial impact.

description: Material impact on a customer team or revenue-impacting workflow.
example_conditions: Whole department blocked, customer demo blocker, billing not running.

description: Critical outage or active security incident.
example_conditions: Site outage, suspected breach, payments halted, broad system unavailability.
